road_camp.track: Clear the Road Camp, west along the old road, and bring Maren fungal caps.
lines: Up, are you? Good. Take a minute if your legs are shaky.
Hollows hauled our tools off to a camp on the old road, west of here. The big one goes by Grub. He painted it on a plank.
I also need fungal caps for bandages. They grow on the trees out that way. Twenty should do.
reminder: West on the old road. Clear out the camp, and bring me twenty caps.
doneLines: Twenty. Watch: crush them, wrap them, and there's your bandage.
Take these. One more thing: rest at the fire and that camp fills right back up. Don't ask me why.

oath.track: Take an oath from a shrine knight and bring it to Maren.
lines: There are knights out at the old shrines, guarding the graves. They don't know why anymore. They just do it.
Beat one and bring me what it carries. Each of them holds onto an oath, and you can put it to use.
reminder: The shrines are out past the fields. Find a knight and bring me what it carries.
doneLines: That's an oath, all right. Hold still.
There. Try it out. Looks like you've done it before.

keep.track: Defeat the Warden in the keep north of the village, and bring Maren what he held onto.
lines: The smithy's been cold since Bram's apprentice left.
He carried the forge up to the old keep for safekeeping, and he's been sitting on it ever since. Doesn't know anyone now.
He won't hand it over. Beat him, and bring back the forge and whatever else he's got.
reminder: The keep's north, up in the hills. He'll fight you for it.
doneLines: This was his? It's still warm.
Keep it. You'll find a use for it.

forge.track: Rebuild the smithy with what the Warden kept.
lines: And you've got the forge. The smithy needs wood and stone before it's any use, though.
Fix it up, and maybe Bram finds his way back.
reminder: The smithy's just past the fire. Wood, stone, and the forge from the keep.
doneLines: Hear that? Someone's at the anvil.
It's Bram. Took me a second to place him.
